② BUILD — your pipeline, your index
extract text · chunk to ~1,500 chars · embed title + content
attach the document's metadata to EVERY chunk

span.p:
chunk 0 │ 10 metadata fields │ vector
chunk 1 │ 10 metadata fields │ vector
chunk n │ 10 metadata fields │ vector
every chunk repeats its parent's metadata
